design_overview: A modern, patient-centric hospital appointment booking system designed for both iOS and Android platforms. The interface prioritizes clarity, ease of navigation, and accessibility for users of all ages. The design employs a clean medical aesthetic with calming colors, clear visual hierarchy, and intuitive touch-friendly components. The system supports three user roles (Patient, Doctor, Administrator) with role-specific interfaces optimized for their unique workflows.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. All touch targets minimum 44x44px for accessibility. Components use flexible layouts with percentage-based widths and max-widths. Cards and lists stack vertically on mobile. Bottom navigation fixed for easy thumb access. Horizontal scrolling used for date pickers and filter chips. Typography scales appropriately with system font size settings. Images use responsive sizing with aspect ratio preservation.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant design. Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI components. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Semantic HTML structure for screen readers. Form inputs have associated labels. Status messages announced to screen readers. Color not used as sole indicator (icons and text accompany color coding). Focus indicators visible for keyboard navigation. Alt text for all images. Support for system font scaling. High contrast mode compatible.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations. Button presses show 100ms scale feedback (0.95x). Cards have 200ms elevation change on tap. Loading states use smooth spinner animations. Modal overlays fade in over 250ms with backdrop blur. List items animate in with staggered 50ms delays. Tab switches use 200ms crossfade. Success confirmations show checkmark animation. All animations respect system reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outline style for clarity. Icons sized 20-24px for UI elements, 40-48px for notification types. Used icons: home (dashboard), search (find doctors), user (profile), settings (preferences), bell (notifications), bookmark (appointments/records), heart (favorites), filter (sorting/filtering), plus (add/book), edit (modify), trash (delete/cancel), share (referrals). Icons always paired with labels for clarity. Primary color for active states, gray for inactive.
